What free allowance does the cited page state? Quote the sentence with the amount, the unit and the period, and set free_tier.stated to it; set free_tier.unit to the unit the page uses; say `not stated` with the URL read when the page prints none.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/blacksmith $.free_tier.metered_on: Page says only "3,000 free min/mo."; it does not say what a minute is counted against, and the same figure sits on every runner size card (2 to 32 vCPU), so wall-clock metering is not stated.
- compute/azure-gpu $.free_tier.unit: The cited URL is a bare JSON retail price feed; the quoted span is only its opening. It states nothing about a free tier (first page lists 12 NC/ND GPU VM rows, all with a positive price, but a price feed does not say there is no free allowance).
- compute/eventual $.verdict: Marketing landing page with no plan, price or terms. A contact link and a "try the demo" link (demo.eventual.ai) are the only calls to action; nothing says the service is paid-only.
- compute/eventual $.free_tier.unit: The page prints no pricing at all, so it cannot show that there is no free tier; it also links a demo.
- compute/azure-gpu $.identity_cost.kind: The cited URL is a JSON retail price feed and says nothing about account sign-up or identity; the card requirement is not on it.
- compute/eventual $.verdict: Page prints no plan or price; a contact link and a demo link do not state that the service is paid-only.
